text:
Sam W.: Heads up — scheduling a short rolling maintenance in us-central1 to apply a microkernel patch + NIC firmware update on inference-serving nodes. Target window: 2026-03-22 02:00-03:30 UTC. Will likely see a few 1-2s API tail-latency blips, should be transparent to most customers. :warning:

IncidentBot: Reminder: run preflight pager test 2h before window. Use `#oncall` bridge if any unexpected alerts.

Marta L: Can we put a clear status page blurb and customer email now? I can draft but need SLO language from Jonah.

Jonah P: SLO impact: no expected availability loss. We may exceed 99.9% p95 token latency for short windows per route if traffic spikes. Recommend adding the usual "possible transient elevated latencies" copy and note backup routing to other regions.

Emily S: Draft for status page: 
```
Service: Redwood Inference (us-central1)
Window: 2026-03-22 02:00-03:30 UTC
Impact: Brief increases in request latency for some workloads. No expected errors or downtime.
What we're doing: rolling kernel + NIC firmware update to improve networking stability.
What we recommend: If you have strict latency SLAs during that window, consider routing to another region or temporarily reducing batch size.
```
LMK edits. :memo:

Sam W.: Good draft. Add contact line: support@redwood.ai and link to status.redwood.ai/us-central1. Also add that we'll post completion note with time + any follow-ups.

Marta L: Ok I'll publish the status page at T-24h and customer email to active Dedicated customers. CS Ops — can you review customer wording? @CS Ops

CS Ops: Reviewing now. Suggest one sentence for contract language: "This maintenance is covered under standard maintenance clause; it does not affect uptime commitments." Also propose a short-headed customer note for sensitive customers.

Jonah P: Oncall plan: two-person handoff. Preflight checklist at T-2h: 1) pager test, 2) validate canary traffic to eu-west1, 3) confirm rollback image available. During window: watch per-route tail latencies, KV cache errors, and serving node counts. Escalation: page infra-sre then eng-oncall.

IncidentBot: Preflight checklist created: `preflight/1849123456-us-central1-kernel-nic` — run `./run_preflight.sh --id=1849123456` and report back.

Sam W.: I'll run the preflight at 00:00 UTC day-of. Jonah — please be available for the handoff. Marta/Emily — please publish T-24h comms once CS Ops signs off.

Marta L: Done. Draft sent to CS Ops for approval (shared doc). Will schedule status.redwood.ai update at 2026-03-21 02:00 UTC.

Emily S: Customer email subject suggestion: "Planned maintenance in us-central1 — potential brief latency spikes (Mar 22)". Short body created, will attach the support link and opt-out routing steps.

Jonah P: Noted. Oncall will be on standby. If we see >=3% tail errors or sustained p95 > 2x baseline for >5m, escalate to pagers.

Sam W.: Thanks team. After the window we'll post a completion note with observed metrics (latency/time to recovery) and any follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
